jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

As a founding Enterprise Account Executive for Iberia, you will own a book of 13-25 Enterprise accounts across Spain and/or Portugal, running full-cycle deals from discovery to close in 3-9 months. You'll sell value directly to operative buyers, with new-logo generation as a core part of the role as we grow Cresta's brand across the region.

As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a portfolio of 13-25 Enterprise accounts in Spain and/or Portugal
  • Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Enterprise AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline
  • Own full sales cycles end-to-end, from discovery through close, typically 3-9 months
  • Sell value directly to operative buyers, building and delivering your own product demos and business cases
  • Prioritize new-logo generation as a key part of growing Cresta's brand and footprint in the region
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience

Qualifications We Value:

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS closing experience as an individual contributor, with consistent quota overachievement in at least 2 of the last 3 years
  • Track record closing deals of €80K-€400K ARR on 3-9 month cycles, running multiple parallel deals end-to-end with limited overlay support, including self-sufficient demos
  • New-logo-first motion, with demonstrated logo velocity rather than an account-management/expansion quota
  • Disciplined outbound pipeline generation — proven self-sourced pipeline alongside SDR/marketing support, with multichannel cadences in Spanish

Nice-to-Have:

  • Direct experience selling CX/contact center software (CCaaS, QA, agent assist, virtual agents) to CX/Operations buyers
  • Early-stage or market-launch experience — comfortable operating without brand pull, playbooks, or local marketing support
  • Salesforce + Gong fluency and strong forecast hygiene
  • Catalan or Portuguese a plus for broader Iberia coverage

Language & Travel:

  • Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus
  • Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed.

Comp: €80K-€100K base, €160K-€200K OTE + equity

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

jobs.jobDescription:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5,000 specialists.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure optimal stock management by monitoring and evaluating the sellout and stock levels of distributors.
  • Lead and manage a team of Area Sales Managers across the region.
  • Handle order flow, delivery, and follow-up to maintain inventory efficiency.
  • Manage partner rebates and credit notes, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
  • Provide actionable insights based on data analysis to drive sales performance and support decision-making.
  • Organize and follow up on training programs for distributors to enhance their product knowledge and sales skills.
  • Support distributor activities related to training, certifications.
  • Develop and evaluate partners' business plans to align with company objectives and drive growth.
  • Develop new markets, participate in sales negotiations, and close deals to expand the company's market presence.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a channel manager/distribution manager in the electronic security or a related industry.
  • Strong focus on achieving sales targets in both sell-in and sell-out channels.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and capitalizing on sales opportunities.
  • Good analytical skills to interpret sales data and make informed decisions.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships with distributors.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills with close attention to detail.

We offer:

  • A product that sells itself.
  • Ambitious tasks and challenges.
  • A strong and well-coordinated team of professionals.
  • Opportunity to work with the most recognized security system and develop your career.
  • A zero bullshit culture.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Spanish native and fluent English; knowledge of the Portuguese language is a plus.
  • Experience in business development, sales, or a related field, preferably in the fire safety or security systems industry.
  • Ability to perform market analysis and contribute to the development of business plans.
  • Knowledge of the Spanish fire markets is required.
  • A basic understanding of other Ajax product lines, including intrusion detection, CCTV, automation, and water systems.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence key stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with a strategic mindset and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Willingness to travel within the Iberia region as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Market Growth & Strategy: Collaborate with the Iberia Country Manager to define a comprehensive business plan and strategy for expanding Ajax's fire system offerings across Spain and Portugal.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify new opportunities, trends, and challenges in the fire safety sector. Develop actionable insights to inform market entry and growth strategies.
  • Business Planning: Support the future growth of Ajax fire systems by contributing to the creation of long-term business strategies and tactical plans to increase market share in the residential and commercial sectors.
  • Regional Expertise: While knowledge of Spanish fire safety markets is an advantage, it is not a requirement. However, understanding and adapting to Iberian market dynamics is essential.
  • Product Knowledge: Gain a solid understanding of the broader Ajax product portfolio, including intrusion detection, CCTV, automation, and water systems, to effectively support cross-product sales and integration.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including sales, marketing, and technical support, to ensure alignment on objectives and to deliver exceptional service to customers.
  • Customer Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including distributors, installers, and end-users, to foster partnerships and drive sales growth.
  • Reporting: Regularly report on market conditions, sales performance, and future opportunities to the Iberia Country Manager and other senior leadership.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary + bonuses;
  • A strong and well-coordinated team of professionals;
  • Ambitious tasks and challenges;
  • Opportunity to grow and develop.

Compensation

Additional Information

We are working to ensure that people's lives are calm and the world safe.

Let's become a part of the team that creates in Ukraine a smart and useful global product.

PS.: Please, send your CV in English
